The Zero Bang Tao

Condominium in Bang Tao
HomeSaleThe Zero Bang Tao

Marketing images, mostly artist renders. Layouts and finishes may differ from the final product.

Project overview

A single seven-storey building of 85 apartments in the Bang Tao area of Choeng Thale, built around an environmental brief: solar panels, rainwater harvesting, energy-efficient heat-resistant glazing and a single-use-plastic-free operation, according to the developer.

The common areas include a 25-metre swimming pool, gym, spa with sauna, steam room and ice bath, a kids club and a co-working space. Unit sizes run from roughly 26 sqm studios to about 95 sqm apartments, and the building is planned as hotel-style, with reception and concierge services.

Boat Avenue is about 3.4 km away and Phuket International Airport about 23 km. Completion is announced for March 2027.

The Zero Bang Tao: key facts

  • The Zero Bang Tao is a low-rise eco condominium in Bang Tao, Phuket, developed by Zero Developments Co., Ltd..
  • Units: 1–2 bedrooms, 27–98 sqm.
  • Construction status: under construction; completion listed as Mar 2027.
  • Ownership listed by sources: Freehold / Leasehold.
  • Advertised starting price: ฿3,900,000.
  • Nearest beach: Bang Tao Beach (1.9 km, driving).
  • Nearby, according to the project data: Bang Tao Beach (1.9 km, driving); Wattanapat Hospital Phuket (4.4 km, straight line); Thalang Hospital (5.7 km, straight line); Bang Tao Night Market (600 m, straight line).
